description: Search USGS or independent global EMSC seismic catalogs by time, magnitude, depth, area and source-specific filters. Both include non-tectonic events; event_type="earthquake" excludes them on USGS. Circle and independently optional box edges intersect. Unsupported EMSC filters appear in ignoredFilters. Size queries with earthquake_count_events. Accepts limit through 20,000, fetches at most 100 candidates, and returns a 24,000-byte page. Continue with offset=nextOffset and unchanged filters/order. totalCount is the full match total when known; countUnavailable marks a failed count lookup, so the total is unknown. Paging can retrieve matches beyond 20,000.

alert_level.description: Minimum PAGER alert level. PAGER estimates economic loss and casualties. "green" = minimal impact; "red" = extreme. Only available from USGS.

end_time.description: End of time range as ISO 8601, in the same forms start_time accepts. Date-only values mean midnight at the start of the named day, not the whole day. Defaults to current time if omitted.

event_type.description: Filter by upstream event classification, e.g. "earthquake" to exclude quarry blasts and explosions, or "quarry blast" to see only those. Matched verbatim against the USGS catalog, which accepts any string and returns zero matches for an unrecognized one. Only available from USGS.

latitude.description: Latitude for radius search. Requires longitude and radius_km.

limit.description: Maximum events to return per call. Default 100. Accepts up to 20000; fetches at most 100 candidates and returns a byte-bounded page. Combine with offset to retrieve match sets larger than one call can return.

longitude.description: Longitude for radius search. Requires latitude and radius_km.

magnitude_type.description: Magnitude type, e.g. "mb" or "mww"; both sources. Blank means omitted.

max_depth_km.description: Maximum depth in kilometers. Bounded to the documented -100 to 1000 km catalog envelope.

max_latitude.description: Northern edge of a bounding-box search, in degrees.

max_longitude.description: Eastern edge of a bounding-box search, in degrees.

min_depth_km.description: Minimum depth in kilometers. Bounded to the documented -100 to 1000 km catalog envelope. Shallow quakes (0–70 km) typically cause more surface damage than deep quakes (>300 km).

min_felt.description: Minimum number of DYFI (Did You Feel It?) reports. Use to find events with confirmed public impact. Only available from USGS.

min_latitude.description: Southern edge of a bounding-box search, in degrees. Independent of the other three box parameters — supply any of them. Must not exceed max_latitude when both are given.

min_longitude.description: Western edge of a bounding-box search, in degrees. Range extends beyond ±180 so a box can cross the antimeridian (e.g. min_longitude=170, max_longitude=190) — always keep min_longitude at or below max_longitude rather than inverting the pair.

min_magnitude.description: Minimum magnitude (Richter or equivalent). M2.5+ is felt by some people; M5+ can cause damage; M7+ is major.

min_significance.description: Minimum USGS significance score (0–2000+). Combines magnitude, felt reports, and PAGER estimates. Significant events typically score 600+. Only available from USGS.

offset.description: Index of the first event to return, counting from 1 — offset=1 is the first match (both upstream APIs reject 0). Omit for the first page, then pass the nextOffset value from a capped result to fetch the next one. Ordering is set by order_by, so keep order_by, limit, and every filter identical across pages.

order_by.description: Sort order. "time" returns newest first; "magnitude" returns largest first.

product_type.description: Required product type, e.g. "moment-tensor"; USGS only. Blank means omitted.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers from the lat/lon point. 100 km covers a metro region; 500 km covers a large country. Max 20001.6, the ceiling USGS enforces. Converted to degrees for EMSC (1° ≈ 111.2 km).

review_status.description: USGS review status: automatic or reviewed. Blank means omitted; unsupported by EMSC.

source.description: USGS includes PAGER, DYFI and ShakeMap; EMSC (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre) is an independent global catalog, with densest station coverage around Europe/Mediterranean and no such impact products. Event-detail tool accepts USGS IDs only.

start_time.description: Start of time range as ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-01-01" or "2026-05-23T00:00:00"). A bare year expands to January 1st and an unpadded month or day is zero-padded, with date-only values resolved to midnight (T00:00:00) on both sources. Explicit time and timezone suffixes are preserved. Defaults to 30 days before end_time (or before the current time) if omitted — applied server-side so USGS and EMSC honor the same window.

name: earthquake_search_events

countUnavailable.description: True if the count lookup failed; events are unaffected, totalCount unknown. Retry earthquake_count_events with identical filters. Absent if count succeeded or was unnecessary.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_range`: Minimum magnitude or depth exceeds its maximum, or start_time is after end_time. `result_too_large`: One event or page metadata cannot fit the response budget. `invalid_radius`: latitude or longitude provided without radius_km, or vice versa. `invalid_bounding_box`: min_latitude exceeds max_latitude, or min_longitude exceeds max_longitude. `source_unavailable`: Selected source API returns a 5xx or is unreachable. `source_timeout`: Selected source API did not answer before the request deadline. `upstream_rejected`: The source API rejected the query parameters and explained why in its response body. `upstream_rejected_no_reason`: The source API rejected the query but its response body carried no usable explanation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

alert.description: PAGER estimated impact; null without an assessment or for EMSC.

auth.description: Authoritative agency/network code (EMSC auth or USGS net); absent if unpublished.

cdi.description: Maximum DYFI Community Decimal Intensity (0–12); null if uncomputed or unsupported (EMSC).

depth_km.description: Hypocenter depth in km; null if unmeasured.

detail_url.description: URL to fetch the full GeoJSON detail record. Present in USGS list responses.

event_certainty.description: EMSC classification certainty: known (asserted), suspected, unknown, or unreported. Suspected is not confirmed. Absent for USGS and unrecognized EMSC codes.

event_type.description: QuakeML classification (earthquake, quarry blast, explosion, etc.). EMSC codes decode to USGS names; unknown codes pass through verbatim. Certainty is separate. Absent if unpublished; either catalog includes non-tectonic events.

event_url.description: USGS event page URL. Present for USGS events only.

felt.description: DYFI (Did You Feel It?) response count; null if no USGS reports or source has no DYFI (EMSC). Null does not mean unfelt.

magnitude.description: Preferred magnitude; null if not computed (title: "M ?").

magnitude_type.description: Magnitude type (ml, mww, mw, mb, etc.).

mmi.description: Maximum ShakeMap Modified Mercalli intensity (0–12); null without a ShakeMap or for EMSC.

significance.description: USGS significance (0–2000+), combining magnitude, felt reports and PAGER; null if uncomputed or for EMSC.

source_catalog.description: Solution catalog, e.g. EMSC-RTS (real-time, subject to revision). Absent for USGS.

status.description: Review state: automatic (unverified), reviewed (analyst checked), or deleted. Null if unpublished (EMSC); such solutions remain unverified and subject to revision.

tsunami.description: USGS tsunami flag: 1 for large oceanic events, 0 otherwise; null if unpublished (EMSC). Not a warning or evidence of a tsunami; check NOAA tsunami.gov for alerts.

updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC time this record was last updated.

ignoredFilters.description: USGS-only filters supplied in the input but not sent upstream because source=emsc does not support them. The result set is NOT constrained by these — re-run with source=usgs to apply them. Absent when every supplied filter was applied.

items.description: Name of an input filter that was not applied.

nextOffset.description: Next 1-based offset; keep other inputs unchanged. Present if more events remain or may remain with unknown total; absent on last page.

notice.description: Recovery guidance when results are empty or capped — how to broaden filters or get the full count. Absent when the result set is non-empty and within the limit.

queryEcho.description: Echo of the effective parameters sent to the upstream API, including server-resolved defaults. Use to diagnose unexpected or empty results — a filter absent here was not sent upstream.

alert_level.description: Applied minimum PAGER alert; absent for EMSC.

end_time.description: Applied end time; absent means upstream current-time default.

event_type.description: Applied event type; absent for EMSC.

max_latitude.description: Northern bounding-box edge sent upstream, in degrees.

max_longitude.description: Eastern bounding-box edge sent upstream, in degrees.

min_felt.description: Applied minimum DYFI response count; absent for EMSC.

min_latitude.description: Southern bounding-box edge sent upstream, in degrees.

min_longitude.description: Western bounding-box edge sent upstream, in degrees.

min_significance.description: Applied minimum significance; absent for EMSC.

offset.description: 1-based paging offset sent upstream. Absent when the first page was fetched.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km sent upstream (converted to degrees for EMSC).

start_time.description: Applied start time; defaults to 30 days before end/now.

totalCount.description: Full match total, inferred from a nonempty short upstream page (or empty first page), otherwise counted for full pages. Absent for empty later pages or failed counts; countUnavailable marks failures.

truncated.description: Page capped by limit, candidates or bytes. Continue with nextOffset. Without totalCount, more events may remain but are not confirmed.

title: Search Earthquakes
